title.fr: Classification et généralités des lentilles minces

sketch:
Observe: SVG bench with a lens slot; student swaps between 6 lens
shapes (biconvex, plan-convex, ménisque convergent, biconcave,
plan-concave, ménisque divergent) via a picker. Parallel rays from a
distant source pass through; convergents focus to a point F',
divergents diverge from a virtual F'. HUD labels type. Experiment:
3 seeded lens cards are shown; student assigns each to "convergente"
or "divergente" by dragging into two bins, judging by shape rules
(thicker-in-middle vs. edges). Evaluate: cards obscured to
silhouettes; classify blind.
